Row.Text: Guardian of Harmony
Nahida dislikes civilizations that declare war on their neighbors. She favors leaders who maintain peaceful relations and strive for regional harmony.
Our paths align in harmony. Let us walk together and grow stronger.
I cannot yet call you "friend." The threads of fate are uncertain for now.
Your heart resonates with peace. Let us join in mutual growth and understanding.
The future is brighter when we work together. Thank you.
Your intentions are clouded. I cannot accept this now.
Conflict was never my wish, but if you seek to disrupt the balance, I must defend my people.
You have disturbed the harmony. This cannot go unchallenged.
Your offering is well received. May it foster deeper understanding between us.
Now is not the time. Our paths must remain separate for a while longer.
I offer these gifts as a symbol of goodwill from the people of Sumeru.
You tread recklessly upon dangerous ground, upsetting the natural order.
Disrupting the harmony of the world will not go unnoticed. (Denounces you)
I am Nahida, protector of knowledge and balance. Let us learn from each other.
Welcome to our lands. The wonders of Sumeru await your discovery.
Your presence brings a sense of peace. Let us continue this path.
Would you share the location of your capital? I will gladly share mine.
Greetings. May our meeting bring wisdom and peace to all.
Your actions have restored balance where there was none. I am grateful.
Be cautious. Your choices risk disturbing the delicate harmony of the world.
Let us unite our strengths and guide our people toward a future of harmony.
Peace at last. May our wounds heal and wisdom prevail.
No, this conflict cannot end under these terms.
Enough blood has been spilled. It is time to end this conflict.
Yes, you may pass freely through our lands.
Our lands must remain closed to outsiders for now.
Your lands are a mystery to us. May we pass through to learn more?
Your armies are far too close to my cities. This threatens the peace between us.
The balance I sought to protect has been shattered.
This deal is not acceptable in its current form.
This agreement benefits us both. Good.
Impressed by peaceful relations with neighboring civilizations
Dislikes your aggression towards neighboring civilizations
